q1.sampleAnswer: They took a field trip to the aquarium.
q1.rubricZh: 要点：去水族馆研学（参观水族馆）。
q1.explanationZh: 第一段第一句就说上周五全班去水族馆研学。

evidence.quote: Last Friday, our class took a field trip to the aquarium.

keyPoints.descZh: 去水族馆研学/参观水族馆
examples: took a field trip to the aquarium

q2.explanationZh: 第二段说企鹅走路的时候看起来很滑稽，游泳时才优雅。

evidence.quote: They looked funny when they were walking.

q3.sampleAnswer: Because staying together enables them to keep each other warm and protect their babies.
q3.rubricZh: 要点：互相取暖；保护幼崽。
q3.explanationZh: 林老师回答说，企鹅聚在一起可以互相保暖，还能保护自己的宝宝。

evidence.quote: They keep each other warm and protect their babies.

q4.rubricZh: 要点：否定回答 No, they didn’t.
q4.explanationZh: 文中说大多数鱼是独自游动的，只有一些小鱼成群，所以回答 No。

evidence.quote: Most of the fish swam around

q5.sampleAnswer: When small fish swim together, they look like a big fish, which prevents a real big fish from realizing that they are in fact a group of small fish.
q5.rubricZh: 要点：聚在一起看起来像一条大鱼；真正的大鱼认不出它们是一群小鱼。
q5.explanationZh: 林老师说小鱼成群游，看起来像一条大鱼，真正的大鱼就不会发现它们其实是一群小鱼，这样就得到了保护。

evidence.quote: But when they swim together, they look like a big fish.

keyPoints.descZh: 聚在一起看起来像一条大鱼
examples: they look like a big fish

keyPoints.descZh: 大鱼不会发现它们是一群小鱼
examples: a real big fish won’t realize

q6.sampleAnswer: I want to see the dolphins most. I think dolphins are very clever and cute. They are very friendly to humans and can do some funny tricks.
q6.rubricZh: 开放题，言之有理即可：先说出想看的海洋动物，再给出理由。
q6.explanationZh: 这是开放题，没有唯一答案。先写出你最想看的动物，再说一个理由，比如它聪明、可爱或有趣。

evidence.quote: The fish were in different shapes, colours and sizes.

examples: I want to see the dolphins most.
I think dolphins are very clever and cute.

q7.explanationZh: 空前有 and，与 jumped 并列，用一般过去时；swim 的过去式是 swam。

q8.explanationZh: and 连接两个形容词/过去分词作表语，felt secure and protected（感到安全并受到保护），用被动含义的 protected。

q9.explanationZh: 介词 with 后面要接名词，excited 的名词形式是 excitement。

q10.explanationZh: bus stop 是“公共汽车站”，这里是名词 stop。

q11.explanationZh: 介词 without 后接动名词，the boy coming 是逻辑主语，所以用 noticing。

q12.explanationZh: 定冠词 the 后面要接名词，real 的名词是 reality（现实）。

q13.explanationZh: 原句是 there was 肯定句，反意疑问句用否定形式 wasn’t there。
q13.tipsZh: there be 句型的反意疑问句，后面用 there

q14.explanationZh: full of 可以换成 filled with，用过去分词 filled 作后置定语：a big tank filled with fish。
q14.tipsZh: be full of = be filled with

q15.explanationZh: 直接引语改间接引语，主句 replied 是过去时，从句也要用过去时，swim 变成 swam。

q16.explanationZh: had a good time 可以换成 enjoyed oneself，主语是 We，所以用 enjoyed ourselves。

q17.explanationZh: 用 It is hard for sb. to do sth. 句型，it 是形式主语；on one’s own 是“独自”：It is hard for baby penguins to live on their own.
q17.tipsZh: It is + 形容词 + for sb. + to do sth.
